Generation Evaluation Workbench
|-- Product surface: EvalsPage
|   |-- Edit prompt versions, capture references and manage layout templates
|   |-- Launch runs; browse experiments, samples and stage outputs
|   `-- Select outputs -> compare side by side -> inspect judgements
|-- Pin the meaning of a run: EvalPromptService + EvalRunService
|   |-- Prompt version -> stage text + content hash + lineage + cited reference text
|   |   |-- Edits append versions; stale base versions are rejected
|   |   `-- Forks and edited attempts retain parent provenance; lineage cycles are rejected
|   |-- AgentContextLibrary -> saved context ID + name + content hash
|   |   `-- Resolve backing sources for execution; reject a changed context hash
|   |-- Canvas inputs -> exact checkpoint copies via CompareSessionService [A]
|   |   `-- Also pin applicable prior alternatives, canvas sets and layout templates
|   |-- Request -> workflow + model + effort + prompt versions + repeated samples
|   |   `-- Same request ID with different content -> conflict
|   `-- Rerun -> reuse matching pinned inputs and prompts
|       `-- Keep original root run and AgentContext ownership
|-- Execute and preserve outputs: EvalRunService
|   |-- Ordinary run cells = prompts x samples x workflow stages
|   |   |-- Save queued run before starting execution
|   |   |-- Run prompt/sample chains with bounded concurrency (default 3)
|   |   `-- Session-delivered context -> serialize sample chains within the run
|   |-- Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- alternatives -> materialize diagrams, optionally into pinned template slots
|   |   |-- diagram-change-proposal -> retain exact proposal tree + display canvas
|   |   |   `-- Preserve tree syntax errors for deterministic assessment
|   |   |-- linked-canvases -> frozen multi-canvas result stored under one cell
|   |   |-- roll-up -> r2 result -> g2 attachment to pinned parent canvas
|   |   |   `-- r2 failure -> skip g2
|   |   |-- few-shot-refinement -> dedicated three-round executor
|   |   |   `-- One prompt, three alternatives per round, progress judgements
|   |   `-- diagram-history -> external coordinator owns launch and recovery
|   |       `-- Cells reference timeline steps; payloads stay in shared checkpoint storage
|   |-- Runtime boundary: AgentContextEvalRuntime
|   |   |-- No session context supplied -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Resolved AgentContext -> independent persisted agent session
|   |       |-- Shared prefix cache key; distinct session ID for each execution
|   |       |-- No tools, context files, skills, automatic retries or compaction
|   |       |-- Prompt + supplementary inputs -> response text -> JSON when parseable
|   |       `-- Capture usage and execution provenance; dispose session on every exit
|   |-- Validation loop: at most 3 generation attempts
|   |   |-- Valid output -> materialize result
|   |   `-- Invalid output -> supply previous output + validation error on next attempt
|   |-- Output evidence
|   |   |-- Generated canvas -> catalog record + pinned checkpoint snapshot
|   |   |-- Cell -> prompt/sample/stage, status, explanation, usage and execution identity
|   |   `-- Completed change-session proposal -> capture exact project/version result
|   |       `-- Pin once without accepting the proposal or starting generation
|   `-- Lifecycle
|       |-- Serialize progress saves; derive run status from cells
|       |-- Mixed finished and unsuccessful cells -> partial run
|       |-- Cancellation -> abort active execution
|       |-- Server restart -> fail interrupted ordinary cells; retain completed outputs
|       `-- Deletion -> cancel, archive outputs and prevent late writes restoring the run
|-- Organize controlled trials: ExperimentService
|   |-- Conditions + input cases + phases -> samples and attempts
|   |   `-- Stage outputs reference run ID + cell key; validate project and context identity
|   |-- Planned generation
|   |   |-- prepareForReview -> freeze prompts and inputs without launching a model
|   |   |-- Map every planned cell to a sample stage exactly once
|   |   `-- Recorded approval -> launchPrepared -> attach run cells to samples
|   |       `-- Persist launch progress; approved plans and inputs cannot be reassigned
|   |-- Edited relaunch -> fork pinned prompt -> new run + incremented attempt
|   `-- Phase comparison -> select cases/conditions -> assess finished proposal trees
|       `-- Store deterministic judgement and attach it to the comparison
|-- Compare independent evidence: CompareSessionService [A]
|   |-- Source = document + optional saved view + checkpoint
|   |   `-- Reject stale view/checkpoint selections
|   |-- copyCompareHistory -> selected endpoint + rendering revisions
|   |   |-- Fresh history context; empty undo/redo stacks
|   |   `-- Deep copy preserves the selected state independently of later canvas edits
|   `-- createPinned -> stored A/B pairs
|       |-- Canvas pairs -> independent cameras and optional focus points
|       `-- Diagram pairs -> exact revision, optional line ranges or subtree
|           `-- Validate every target against the captured snapshot
|-- Preserve assessments: JudgementService
|   |-- Reconcile comparison sessions/jobs -> independently typed records
|   |   |-- canvas-comparison
|   |   |-- diagram-comparison
|   |   `-- comparison-report
|   |-- Native workflow results -> few-shot-progress or diagram-change-tree
|   |-- Each judgement owns subjects and run attachments
|   |   `-- One assessment may cover outputs from several runs
|   `-- Retain evaluator identity, status, evidence and source fingerprint
|       `-- Deletion tombstones prevent reconciliation from recreating the judgement
`-- Promote completed evidence: EvalRunService -> project catalog
    |-- Resolve finished cell -> timeline result, frozen result bundle or canvas checkpoint
    |-- prepareOutputPromotion -> destination documents
    |   |-- New canvas project -> include project group
    |   `-- Existing canvas -> require settled eligible target at expected revision
    |       `-- Reject unsaved workspace edits before publication
    `-- publishOutputPromotion -> catalog receipt + run/cell placement provenance
        |-- Same request ID + signature -> return prior receipt
        `-- Conflicting signature -> reject reuse
